milestone.title: test infrastructure quality — split lib_api.rs mega-helper and dedup seed/gig-git helpers across suites

intent.outcome: Common mp test helpers are organized by domain instead of one 1,134-line file, and seed_handoff_gate / init_git are each defined once and imported by every suite that needs them.

problem.description: crates/mp/tests/common/lib_api.rs is 1,134 lines (PlanContext bootstrap, milestone/step/wp/ac mutations, validate, git, JSON parsing, dup2-based capture_stdio at :1026, run_with_retry) and is pulled into 55 test files via `mod common;`. It is hard to navigate and review. Separately, `seed_handoff_gate(env: &TestEnv)` is duplicated in crates/mp/tests/suites/plan_diff.rs:33 and suites/digest.rs:6, and `init_git(env: &TestEnv)` in suites/git_suggest.rs:6 and suites/p12_recommendation_batch.rs:5. Note: because every integration-test binary compiles its own copy of `mod common`, splitting the file does NOT reduce recompilation when a helper changes — this milestone is a readability/dedup refactor, not a build-time optimization.

in_scope: Split crates/mp/tests/common/lib_api.rs into crates/mp/tests/common/lib_api/{ctx.rs, mutation.rs, io.rs, capture.rs} with lib_api.rs reduced to module declarations + re-exports, so existing `common::lib_api::*` imports keep compiling.

Move seed_handoff_gate into crates/mp/tests/common/seed.rs and init_git into crates/mp/tests/common/git.rs (declared from common/mod.rs); switch suites/plan_diff.rs, suites/digest.rs, suites/git_suggest.rs, suites/p12_recommendation_batch.rs to import them.
Record the `cargo nextest list -p mp` test count before and after; the refactor must not drop tests.
CHANGELOG entry noting the test-helper refactor (no behavior change).
out_of_scope: Redesigning the TestEnv or mp_bin_snapshot contract.
Adding new helpers; the refactor is purely structural.
Build-time optimization (e.g. a separate test-support crate) — splitting modules inside `common` cannot achieve it.
Touching crates/raul/tests/, which has its own smaller scaffold.

acceptance_criteria.description: crates/mp/tests/common/lib_api.rs is under 100 lines (module declarations + re-exports) and its bodies live in crates/mp/tests/common/lib_api/{ctx,mutation,io,capture}.rs.
acceptance_criteria.verification: test "$(wc -l < crates/mp/tests/common/lib_api.rs)" -lt 100 && test -f crates/mp/tests/common/lib_api/ctx.rs && test -f crates/mp/tests/common/lib_api/capture.rs

acceptance_criteria.description: seed_handoff_gate, init_git, and capture_stdio are each defined exactly once under crates/mp/tests/.
acceptance_criteria.verification: test "$(rg 'fn seed_handoff_gate\b' crates/mp/tests | wc -l)" -eq 1 && test "$(rg 'fn init_git\b' crates/mp/tests | wc -l)" -eq 1 && test "$(rg 'fn capture_stdio\b' crates/mp/tests | wc -l)" -eq 1

acceptance_criteria.description: The refactor drops no tests: the cargo nextest list -p mp count after the change is >= the baseline recorded before it (baseline recorded in step S1.2 evidence).
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: compare 'cargo nextest list -p mp | wc -l' against the baseline recorded in S1.2 evidence

acceptance_criteria.description: All mp tests pass after the refactor; clippy and fmt are clean.
acceptance_criteria.verification: cargo nextest run -p mp --no-fail-fast && cargo clippy -p mp --tests --no-deps -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --all -- --check

work_packages.name: lib_api split
work_packages.goal: crates/mp/tests/common/lib_api.rs becomes a thin re-export shim or is removed in favor of crates/mp/tests/common/lib_api/<domain>.rs
work_packages.rollback: Restore the monolithic lib_api.rs; consumers re-import the same surface

work_packages.name: Helper dedup
work_packages.goal: seed_handoff_gate and init_git are defined once; no tests lost; suite green
work_packages.rollback: Restore the duplicated helpers in each suite

steps.action: Split crates/mp/tests/common/lib_api.rs into per-domain submodules: crates/mp/tests/common/lib_api/{ctx.rs, mutation.rs, io.rs, capture.rs}.
Move capture_stdio (lib_api.rs:1026-1108) into crates/mp/tests/common/lib_api/capture.rs, re-exported from lib_api.rs so the 55 importers keep compiling unchanged.
BEFORE any edit: record the baseline 'cargo nextest list -p mp | wc -l' in this step's evidence. After S1/S1.1/S2 land, re-run and confirm the count is >= baseline.

Move seed_handoff_gate into crates/mp/tests/common/seed.rs and init_git into crates/mp/tests/common/git.rs (declared in common/mod.rs); switch suites/plan_diff.rs, suites/digest.rs, suites/git_suggest.rs, suites/p12_recommendation_batch.rs to import them.
steps.tests: test "$(rg 'fn seed_handoff_gate\b' crates/mp/tests | wc -l)" -eq 1 && test "$(rg 'fn init_git\b' crates/mp/tests | wc -l)" -eq 1
